text:
mira-docs: Heads up I submitted a tiny docs PR to update the audit log page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/589 — mainly retention wording and three SDK examples (py/js/cli).

sam-legal: Quick legal note: please avoid words like 'permanently' or 'forever' on public pages. SOC2 auditors flagged optimistic language before. Recommend: 'retained per customer-configured policy; Redwood does not retain logs beyond configured retention except where required by law or legal holds.'

eli-eng: thanks. also caught a mismatch in the JS example. New SDK uses `retention` object rather than a top-level `expireInSeconds`. Proposed fix below:
```diff
- client.audit.create({tenant: 'acct_99', expireInSeconds: 86400})
+ client.audit.create({tenant: 'acct_99', retention: {mode: 'ttl', seconds: 86400}})
```

mira-docs: good catch @eli-eng. I'll swap examples across languages. @nina-privacy any phrasing tweaks for the public privacy-friendly line?

nina-privacy: I like Sam's wording. Maybe add one short sentence about pseudonymization: 'Customers may enable pseudonymization of PII within audit logs; see API examples.' avoids technical detail in the prose.

sam-legal: +1 but change 'may enable' -> 'can enable' reads better for docs. Also remove internal links — put '(contact support for legal playbook)' instead.

eli-eng: adding a short CLI example for customers migrating infra:
```
# show policy
rctl audit get --tenant acct_99 --json
# example output
{
  "tenant":"acct_99",
  "retention": {"mode":"ttl","seconds":86400},
  "pseudonymize": false
}
```

mira-docs: I'll drop the internal playbook link and add support hint. Updating the py/js/curl snippets to match the retention shape and to include the pseudonymize flag.

ci-bot: PR #589 1 checks: unit-tests: passed, link-checker: warning (removed internal link), linter: passed

mira-docs: pushed the change for wording and snippets. @sam-legal @nina-privacy can you quick-approve? I kept the public copy concise and added a short 'how to migrate' note for SDKs.

sam-legal: approved from legal once internal link removed.

nina-privacy: LGTM. thanks for adding the pseudonymize example.

mira-docs: merged and scheduled to staging docs. Thanks everyone! :tada:
